recognize_zh: 大型細胞呈片狀浸潤，核卵圓、染色質泡狀、核仁明顯，部分細胞核偏位並具雙嗜色細胞質（漿細胞樣分化），可見分裂相與壓扁的深染核；這種帶漿細胞樣特徵的大細胞淋巴瘤外觀是漿母細胞淋巴瘤的線索。
features: Sheets of large atypical cells with oval nuclei, vesicular chromatin and prominent central nucleoli
Subset with eccentric nuclei and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm suggesting plasmacytoid differentiation
Admixed crushed hyperchromatic nuclei and apoptotic cells; scattered mitotic figures
Thin fibrovascular septum crossing the field; no nodular architecture
describe_en: Sections show diffuse sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells traversed by a thin fibrovascular band. The neoplastic cells have oval vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli; many show eccentrically placed nuclei and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, imparting a plasmablastic appearance. Mitotic figures, apoptotic bodies and crushed hyperchromatic nuclei are present. Morphology alone does not separate this from other high-grade B-cell lymphomas, but in the context of a CD20-negative, MUM1/CD138-positive and EBER-positive immunophenotype, the findings are consistent with EBV-positive plasmablastic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: DLBCL is CD20/PAX5 positive, whereas plasmablastic lymphoma lacks pan-B markers and expresses MUM1/CD138.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic plasma cell myeloma / plasmablastic myeloma
ddx.vs: Myeloma is supported by marrow-based disease, M-protein and lytic lesions and is usually EBER negative.
ALCL shows hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei and strong uniform CD30 with T-cell or ALK expression, not a plasma cell program.
Cohesive nests and keratin or S100/SOX10 expression exclude a hematolymphoid neoplasm that lacks CD45 and CD20.
